page.layout: One page of running text. Printed page number and running head at the top. Notes in the left margin: "Ananias cum suis in camin." at the start of the page, "a viri." and "b similem filio Dei. Vide notas." further down, and "Dan. 4." beside the line "vit: confessus". Catchword "pore" at the lower right.

main_text.p: igitur rei ex edicto regis constituuntur: propositaq; eis conditio poenarum ardes caminus, ut praesenti metu adorare statuā cogerentur. Verum illi devorari ignibus, quam piaculum committere, maluerunt. Ananias cum suis in camin. cum con- jectus. Itaque vincti pedibus in medias flammas coniiciuntur. Sed miniftros infandi operis, dum promptius damnatos in ignem propellunt, flamma absorbuit: Hebræos (mirum dictu & incredibile non visenti- bus) ignis non attigit, quum afpectanti- bus deambulantes in camino psalmum Deo dicere cernerentur. Visufque cum his inter ignem quartus specie {a}angeli, a viri. quem Nabuchodonosor propius intui- tus, {b}filiū Dei se vidisse confessus est. Tū rex haud dubius divinā in re praesenti fu- b similem filio Dei. Vide notas. ipse[?] virtutem, mifsis per omne regnum suum edictis, facti miraculum provulga- vit: confessus, soli Deo honorem defe- rendum. Dan. 4. Nec multo post, rex objecto sibi somnio, mox voce etiam coelo emissa, admonitus, poteftate regia abjecta, atq; ab omni conversatione humana remotus, herbis tantum vitam fuftinens, egisse poenitentiam traditur. page.notes: Page is a single column of text with marginal notes on the left. The catchword "pore" is printed below the last line; the word "tempore" is split across the line end. Uncertain reading: "ifse" printed, transcribed as "ipse[?]". The notes "Ananias" and "Dan. 4." are short marginal references; their mark letters were not clearly visible, so they carry no letter attribute. Text is printed with long-s and abbreviations as they appear; the running head was normalised to SULPICII SEVERI for u/v spelling.
